title: BioTRUST — Relaunch Review
description: Independent pre-relaunch review of biotrust.com by Mousa Batarseh — indexable staging, split canonicals, a $36/$49 price mismatch, and a clickable go-live gate. For the Technical Ecommerce Manager role.

blocks.text: SEC. 01 — OVERVIEW · FOR THE TECHNICAL ECOMMERCE MANAGER ROLE
Before the relaunch, the store is showing its work.

The posting wants someone who has done a relaunch, not watched one — and who protects site health while it happens. So I ran the pre-flight on biotrust.com. Staging is public and indexable. robots.txt runs its rules together on one line. Every page carries two title tags and two canonicals. A homepage card prices a product at $36 that the product page sells at $49. This is the flight deck I'd hand your Head of Growth & Ecommerce in week one.
products in a public, indexable staging store

THE ASK
Own the relaunch
“Read and edit Liquid… fix the thing rather than file a ticket.” The defects below are one theme change each — the work the role describes.
THE RISK
A relaunch copies defects
Staging indexed next to production, split canonicals and invalid Product schema all carry forward unless someone gates go-live on them.
THE GATE
A pre-flight you can click
Section 03 is a working readiness gate: blockers can't be waived, and the readiness score only reaches GO when they're cleared.
